title: The support of a product current [[E]] × A lies in E + spt A
statement: Let P, k, m', n' ∈ ℕ, E ⊆ ℝ^P compact, A ∈ 𝒟_{m'}(ℝ^P) with spt A compact and an integer multiplicity representation R_A of A (R_A.Represents A), and B ∈ 𝒟_{n'}(ℝ^P) with an integer multiplicity representation R_B (R_B.Represents B). Suppose R_B.measure(C) = ∫⁻_{t ∈ E} R_A.measure((y ↦ t + y)⁻¹(C)) dμHE[k](t) for every Borel set C. Then spt B ⊆ E + spt A = {t + y : t ∈ E, y ∈ spt A} (Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) E A.support).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k m' n' : ℕ) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m') (RA : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m') (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (RB : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n'), IsCompact E → IsCompact A.support → RA.Represents A → RB.Represents B → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet C → RB.measure C = ∫⁻ t in E, RA.measure ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' C) ∂μHE[k]) → B.support ⊆ Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) E A.support
